human_data.miti.casaa.gold: 20 transcripts (18 clean): the only human MITI-coded spoken data we hold

not_mappable: Seek: neither MISC (folds permission-seeking into EC) nor Welivita has it
notes: CASAA is too small to train on and is the reference standard, so it is never used for training or tuning.

training_options.if obtained: MI-TAGS (MITI 4.2, 242 sessions) after dedup against HLQC, AnnoMI and CASAA
training_options.recommended: pooled in MITI space: welivita.gold (stage-I-agreed labels, mapped with schemes.mappings.WELIVITA_TO_MITI; Self-Disclose dropped) + MISC gold mapped with MISC_TO_MITI. Proxy on CASAA (all routes trained on MITI-mapped labels): macro-F1 0.339 vs 0.247 (MISC gold only) and 0.303 (Welivita only)
training_options.welivita_folds: use welivita_own folds for MITI-space dev/selection; CASAA stays test only

welivita_to_miti: schemes.mappings.WELIVITA_TO_MITI (exact 57% / approximate 34% / none 8% of listener labels)
